name: tare-web
description: Tare's framework-free browser and Tauri workbench UI.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/ui dist/assets && cp src/ui/*.css dist/ui/ && cp -R assets/. dist/assets/ && cp index.html dist/index.html
